newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair in cargo link with CityBird.
newsitem.headline: Swissair in cargo link with CityBird.

text.p: Swisscargo AG, the cargo unit of Swissair AG, said it will expand its capacity by around 150 metric tonnes per week via a link-up with Belgium's CityBird.
"From March 27, 1997, Swisscargo...will market the entire cargo capacity on scheduled flights of Belgian CityBird," Swisscargo said.

"Within the framework of a formal contract Swisscargo purchases the cargo capacity of CityBird between Brussels and Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami and Newark and markets it through its own distribution channels," Swisscargo said.
The move is in addition to Swissair cargo capacities through its own carrier, as well as through its regional airline Crossair and Belgian carrier Sabena, in which Swissair holds 49.5 percent.

Swisscargo said in its latest statement the link with CityBird will offer it an additional 10 weekly flights employing two McDonnell Douglas MD-11 aircraft. The addition capacity will mean Swisscargo "now markets the cargo space of four airlines to 179 destinations," Swisscargo said.
CityBird is a trans-Atlantic low-fare airline which started service last year. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
